phase.writing: Writing the mails into the file
phase.finishing: Finishing the file and its checksum list

eml_zip.label: EML files in a ZIP
eml_zip.description: Every mail as its own .eml file, sorted into the folder structure, plus a checksum list. Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail and most other mail programs open these files.

mbox.label: MBOX
mbox.description: The common mailbox format of Thunderbird and many migration tools. One .mbox file per folder inside a ZIP, or a single .mbox file when you export one folder.

msg_zip.label: MSG files in a ZIP
msg_zip.description: Outlook message files in the folder structure. They are rebuilt from the mail, not from the original bytes, so details can differ from the original.

pst.label: PST (Outlook data file)
pst.alternative: Outlook can open the EML export by drag and drop, or import the MBOX file with common tools.

expiry.hours: The download link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}{minutes, plural, =0 {} one { and # minute} other { and # minutes}}.
expiry.minutes: The download link expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
expiry.soon: The download link expires in less than a minute.

cancel.title: Cancel this export?
cancel.description: The export stops at the next mail and no file is kept. You can start it again at any time.
cancel.failed: The export could not be cancelled.

page.title: Export
page.description: The file is prepared in the background. You can download it here as long as the link is valid.
page.loadError: The export could not be loaded.

progress.title: Export in progress
progress.queued: Waiting for a free worker. The export starts shortly.
progress.running: The mails are being written into the file.
progress.label: Export progress
progress.failed: {count, plural, one {# mail failed} other {# mails failed}}
progress.eta: about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left
progress.leaveHint: You can leave this page. The export keeps running and stays listed under Exports.

result.title: Result
result.failedUnknown: No further details were reported. Start the export again, or check the worker log.
result.cancelledDescription: No file was kept. Start a new export when you need one.
result.noReport: There is no report for this export, so how many emails the file holds is not known.
result.checksumHint: Compare it with the checksum of the downloaded file to prove that nothing changed.

expired.title: The download link has expired
expired.description: The file was deleted from the server when the link expired ({date}). Request the export again to get a new file.

failures.title: Mails that could not be exported

failures.descriptionLive: These mails could not be exported so far. The export continues with the others.
